summary: ProClinic Fase 2 RETEST — backend only. All fixes from iteration 2 verified. Phase 2: 26/26 pytest PASS (was 22/24; added 2 new validation tests for MIME whitelist and empty body). Phase 1 regression: 19/19 pytest PASS (no regressions). Grand total: 45/45 (100%).

minor.issue: init_storage() uses sync `requests` inside an `async` handler; blocks event loop for 12MB uploads. Use `httpx.AsyncClient` or `run_in_threadpool` (carry-over from iteration 2, NON-blocking for tests).
Explicit '..' / leading-slash rejection still missing on the serve route (upload route filters filename but the GET path:path is regex-anchored — fine for now, just defensive nit).

action_items: Carry-over (LOW): wrap put_object in run_in_threadpool for true async uploads.
Carry-over (LOW): a11y — add <DialogDescription> to Radix DialogContent (Phase 2 dialogs).
critical_code_review_comments: update_attendance fix is clean and correct: model_dump(exclude_unset=True) + explicit .pop of identity fields gives belt-and-suspenders defense.
MIME whitelist set _ALLOWED_UPLOAD_MIMES is right-sized for an aesthetic clinic (jpeg/png/webp/gif/pdf). Filename traversal check ('..' or '/') is in place.
MessageIn.body Field(min_length=1) correctly returns 422 (Pydantic validation) — confirmed by new test_create_empty_body_rejected.
server.py is now ~1395 lines — split recommendation from iteration 2 still stands but is non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing Phase 1 seed. TEST_-prefixed transient records created+cleaned during finalize/by-appointment tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three Iteration-2 HIGH/medium bugs are FIXED and covered by automated tests: (1) PUT /api/attendance/{session_id} now uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) AND explicitly pops appointment_id/patient_id — autosave preserves identity, by-appointment finds the session, finalize correctly marks appointment 'concluido'. (2) POST /api/uploads rejects non-whitelisted MIME with 400 (allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, application/pdf). (3) MessageIn.body has Field(min_length=1) → empty body returns 422. Run /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_api.py and test_proclinic_api.py — current baseline is 45/45 green. Frontend testids and Phase 2 critical flows already validated in iteration 2.
rca of the issue: All previously reported root causes addressed in iteration-2 fix and verified here. update_attendance now scopes the update set strictly to fields the client sent and explicitly removes identity fields — eliminates the autosave wipe of appointment_id.
